newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pfleiderer sees dividend steady at least.
newsitem.headline: Pfleiderer sees dividend steady at least.

text.p: Germany's Pfleiderer AG said on Tuesday it planned to pay a dividend on 1996/1997 results which at least matched the amount of 18 marks paid for 1995/1996.
The company's business year runs to May 31.
Earlier, Pfleiderer said it would merge its activities under a new shareholding company which it plans to list on the Frankfurt stock exchange.

The company said its listed subsidiary Pfleiderer Bau- und Verkehrsysteme AG, which makes construction and transport equipment, as well as Pfleiderer GmbH, a holding company, will be merged with Pfleiderer AG.
The merged company Pfleiderer AG then plans to raise its capital in the final quarter of 1997.
